questions.question: the game is really stuttering and skipping around the whole time I'm trying to play it
questions.tip_text: Give the game a minute after launch -- shaders compiling for the first time cause stutter that goes away.

questions.question: no sound at all coming out
questions.tip_text: If there is no sound at all, check the in-game audio settings too, not just the Deck's.
questions.note: check in-game audio settings too - answers it

questions.question: storage full cant install anything else
questions.tip_text: Internal storage full: uninstall large shaders and unused games first.
questions.note: uninstall shaders and unused games - answers it

questions.question: screen looks torn and glitchy
questions.tip_text: If the screen looks torn while moving the camera, turn on V-Sync in the game's display settings.

questions.question: it gets really hot and battery drains so fast
questions.tip_text: Lower the TDP limit in Quick Settings if the Deck feels hot or the fan is loud.
questions.note: lower the TDP limit - answers it

questions.question: it gets uncomfortably warm in my hands after a little while and the battery seems to drain a lot quicker than it used to
questions.tip_text: TDP cap in QAM affects CPU/GPU together; lowering reduces heat.
questions.note: TDP cap reduces heat - answers it

questions.question: update stuck wont finish installing
questions.tip_text: SteamOS update stuck: reboot and retry; recovery image if boot loop.

questions.question: when I plug it into the television the menus show up in the wrong spot on the screen and are hard to read
questions.tip_text: Big Picture Mode is default on Deck; Desktop Mode for Konsole and file fixes.
questions.note: OFF SUBJECT. The question is about a TV showing menus in the wrong place (overscan on an external screen). The tip returned is 'Big Picture Mode is default on Deck; Desktop Mode for Konsole and file fixes', which does not address it.
